symptoms.title: No supported disease pattern
symptoms.description: The image did not show a strong pattern for Black Sigatoka, Panama Disease, or Cordana Leaf Spot. This is not proof that the whole plant is disease-free.

symptoms.title: Inspect the whole plant
symptoms.description: Check both leaf surfaces, older and younger leaves, the pseudostem, and the plant base for yellowing, spots, wilting, splitting, or internal discoloration.

symptoms.title: Watch for changes
symptoms.description: Symptoms can be absent or subtle in an early infection. Compare the plant over time and scan a clear, well-lit image of any new symptom.

treatment.title: Keep functional leaves
treatment.description: Maintain approximately 8–15 functional leaves to support healthy banana plant growth and development.

treatment.title: Remove nonfunctional leaves
treatment.description: Remove old, diseased, dried, and nonfunctional leaves as part of regular plant maintenance.

treatment.title: Trim instead of removing the whole leaf
treatment.description: When more than 50% of a leaf remains healthy, trim the affected portion rather than removing the entire leaf.

treatment.title: Practice de-leafing and sanitation
treatment.description: Practice regular de-leafing and field sanitation to prevent unnecessary accumulation of damaged or diseased foliage.

treatment.title: Control weeds
treatment.description: Maintain appropriate weed-control practices to reduce competition for water and nutrients.

treatment.title: Provide water and drainage
treatment.description: Provide adequate water for plant growth while maintaining proper drainage, particularly in flood-prone areas.

treatment.title: Inspect leaf condition
treatment.description: Regularly inspect leaves for discoloration, lesions, drying, or other visible symptoms of disease.

treatment.title: Preserve healthy foliage
treatment.description: Maintain healthy foliage as part of an overall crop-management strategy rather than removing leaves unnecessarily.

prevention.title: Inspect for early symptoms
prevention.description: Regularly inspect banana leaves to identify disease symptoms at an early stage.

prevention.title: Remove dried and diseased foliage
prevention.description: Remove dried and diseased foliage promptly while preserving functional healthy leaves.

prevention.title: Avoid unnecessary leaf removal
prevention.description: Avoid unnecessary removal of healthy leaves because functional foliage contributes to plant maintenance and development.

prevention.title: Maintain water management
prevention.description: Maintain adequate drainage and appropriate water management.

prevention.title: Keep the field clean
prevention.description: Practice regular weed control and field sanitation.

prevention.title: Monitor functional leaves
prevention.description: Monitor the number and condition of functional leaves throughout crop development.

prevention.title: Prune leaves properly
prevention.description: Use proper leaf-pruning practices to maintain sufficient healthy foliage.
